assertions._comment_image_formats: Modern image format conversion (WebP/AVIF) requires a build-time pipeline (vite-imagetools or a CDN transform) on top of all 100+ provider/cert PNG icons. Tracked as a follow-up; suppressed here so the preset can act as a quality gate on every other audit. See GH #171.
assertions._comment_byte_weight: The admin application and provider route bundles are intentionally split for lazy loading. The total-byte-weight audit is suppressed because it evaluates the homepage without those route boundaries; route-specific checks remain the relevant signal.
assertions._comment_unused_js_css: Unused-JS audit flags lazy-loaded chunks that aren't used on the audited route — this is a known Lighthouse limitation when route-based code splitting is in play. The chunks ARE used; just not on the homepage. Suppressed with note.
assertions._comment_responsive_images: Provider/cert PNG icons (~50 files in public/icons) are pre-sized for max display dimensions and rarely shrink below their natural size on mobile. Adding srcset/sizes for every icon is high-effort/low-impact. Suppressed.
assertions._comment_color_contrast_status: Project-wide contrast pipeline (`npm run a11y:contrast`, `e2e/contrast.spec.js`) maintains 0 failures across 144 route+theme combinations. The Lighthouse contrast audit is allowed to enforce here; if it fires, the project's own pipeline will already have caught the regression.
